notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on August 7th
notes.content:
Adventurers, here are today's update notes:

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimized the cursor movement slowdown and zoom functions in the menu interface when using the controller operation mode.

2. Added a mission to activate the stele feature after first entering the Ruins Realm.

3. Optimized Kaku's appearance after transformation, changing Kaku's clothes from white to gold.

4. Optimized some task prompts, describing the need for disguise with "Piggy Disguise."

5. Optimized performance in certain scenes.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where Geiser on the "Floating Island" sometimes couldn't swap BOSS equipment. 

2. Fixed an issue where some Ponpon quest badges in the "Flame Mountains" could not be picked up. 

3. Fixed an issue with the main quest NPC location in "Misty Swamp" during the quest "Find the Relic (III)". 

4. Fixed an issue where saving before resource initialization in "Misty Swamp" could reset mechanisms like the Crystal Tower and Ruins Key. 

5. Fixed an issue where the main quest in the "Dragonbone Desert" was not triggered successfully. 

6. Fixed an issue where some Ponpon Book quests might not activate. 

7. Fixed an issue in the "Flame Mountains" where players would die infinitely in lava after deleting a save. 

8. Fixed an issue where the "Kill the Ponpon Captain" achievement was not awarded after killing some Ponpon Captain. 

9. Fixed an issue in the "Dragonbone Desert" where the temple's stone walls would not move, causing a stuck state. 

10. Fixed an issue in the "Howling Snowfield" where using the Ground Fissure Earthquake to kill a stag during the slow-motion process prevented the doe from reviving the stag. 

11. Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain in certain scenes. 

12. Fixed an issue where some treasure chests would glitch after being opened. 

We will continue to make fixes and optimizations as soon as possible.  If you encounter problems during the game, please give us feedback, thank you for your support!

notes.title: FAQs Before the Full Version Release
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

The day when the EA version transitions to the full release is approaching. 

[h3]Here we address some of the most recent and frequently asked questions. [/h3]

[h3][b]Q: Can we continue to play the EA version?[/b][/h3]
A: Unfortunately, due to significant changes in the full version, including a complete reset of the prologue and the main character, and the addition of numerous new gameplay, you will need to start a new game after the full version update.

[h3][b]Q: Do I need to purchase the full version if I already bought the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
A: Players who have purchased the Early Access version will receive a free upgrade to the full version upon its release.

[h3][b]Q: Will there be more new content updates in the future?[/b][/h3]
A: While creating the full version, we already had some new ideas. However, after the full release, we will prioritize optimizing the game. The new content that everyone is looking forward to will come after that. Please stay tuned for the latest official news.

[h3][b]Q: Will the game support PC game controllers/Steamdeck?[/b][/h3]
A: In the full version, we will enable customizable button functions for controllers, allowing you to adjust to your preferred settings. The Steamdeck adaptation is almost complete, and Steam is currently reviewing it. After stabilizing the full version, we will continue to optimize the Steamdeck adaptation.

[h3][b]Q: What should I do if I encounter a black screen or long loading times when opening the game?[/b][/h3]
A: If the game is installed on a HDD, it may take longer to load resources the first time you open the game due to the drive's read speed. Please be patient. We also recommend using a SSD to run the game. Using an integrated graphics card might cause similar issues. We will continue to monitor this issue after launch. Thank you for your understanding.

[h3][b]Q: Is it more cost-effective to buy the game now?[/b][/h3]
A: The game is currently available at an all-time low discount. Purchasing now will also grant you the Launch Exclusive Content and the Soundtrack.

[h3][b]Q: Will the game support console versions, or is it only playable on Steam?[/b][/h3]
A: The game is currently only available on Steam, but we are preparing for console platform ports. We will share any new developments with everyone.

[h3][b]Q: Can we still play the Demo after the full release?[/b][/h3]
A: We know that the Demo is the most direct and fastest way to understand the gameplay. Therefore, the current free Demo will remain available after the game's release.

[h3][b]Q: I purchased a key and activated it after the full release, can I still get the EA Exclusive Rewards?[/b][/h3]
A: No. If you have already purchased a key, make sure you activate it and deposit the game in your library before the official release.

[h3]If you have any other unresolved queries, feel free to leave a message in the community.[/h3]

notes.title: The Full Version of KAKU: Ancient Seal will launch July 12th!
notes.content:
To Adventurers:

[h3]After a year of polishing, the Full Release version of KAKU: Ancient Seal will be launched on Steam on [b]July11th at 10PM EDT / 7PM PDT / July 12th 2AM UTC![/b][/h3]

[h3]Starting at [b]$24.99[/b] with a two week-long discount price of [b]$18.70[/b].[/h3]

[h3]let's break the seal on our [b]Release Date Trailer[/b]:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=s9B0HQpSVU8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a15da320972f1c721ebc3dd2ee82cfb67685c57d.png[/img]


Following extensive rounds of internal and player beta testing, the full version now offers well beyond 30 hours of content.

Delve into a reimagined adventure with our redesigned protagonist, accompanied by new content including open-world gameplay, a dynamic runestone system, a transformation system, and the enigmatic Realm of Ruins. Additionally, meticulous sound effects, controls, UI, and performance optimisations have been implemented. Together, these enhancements offer a fresh experience that ensures even returning players will be amazed.

You can read up on all the detailed changes & improvements below:

[h3]1. Four expansive maps[/h3]
Explore the diverse landscapes and terrains of the Flame Mountains, Dragonbone Desert, Misty Swamps, and Howling Snowfield. Each continent boasts its own unique features, from lush forests and towering volcanoes to sprawling plains and icy glaciers, ensuring a breathtaking journey filled with untold wonders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/610d301939682c1a23d475b6916494550778002c.gif[/img]

[h3]2. Revamped combat mechanics - Three unique styles[/h3]
Compared to the Early Access version's combat system, the Full Release has removed less practical skills, optimized the fluidity of actions, combat pacing, and other details, and redesigned the UI of the skill tree. Additionally, almost all skills have added two enhanced branches, which players unlock by engaging in combat throughout the game.

The main-hand weapon, off-hand armblade, and ranged slingshot will have more unique skill styles, each with their own advantages and disadvantages. However, players can switch to another combat style at any time, and get all resources refunded. Try out all the elemental abilities that come with your divine powers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/8352ef8ccd02512573c3446a3a56f22d8ad498df.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Unlock Divine Powers[/h3]
Embody the incarnation of Saga the Creator in epic battles, and unleash your mighty attacks that will stop your opponents in their tracks. ​ Reclaim the Blank Stele to unlock even more transfiguration techniques that give additional boosts and let loose with wide-range attacks which deal dazzling amounts of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/c876f1f25f1e44a06783e160e874cda61fb03164.gif[/img]

[h3]4. Epic Boss Battles[/h3]
Venture into hidden corners of the continent to confront the leaders of the Elemental Temples. Face the relentless roaming lords of the wilderness who ruthlessly repel every intruder. In the lost outer realm, an ultimate darkness seeks to plunge the world into chaos. Commanding the power of all elements, this adversary stands as the most formidable challenge you will face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/0bbe0b11ffff9b7ba27dd50971816faa8fc570e6.gif[/img]

[h3]5. Equipment & Rune Stones Create Infinite Possibilities[/h3]
All equipment has been completely revamped, featuring more distinct attributes. New embeddable rune stones, which interact with each other, open up endless possibilities for customization. Obtain a wide array of equipment, accessories, and rune stones by defeating bosses and exploring maps. Freely combine and match them to master your unique combat style and push beyond your limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/98f6c1aca4917f0a436182b2745dc52448f7deb4.gif[/img]

[h3]6. The New Realm of Ruins is waiting for you[/h3]
Saga The Creator has unveiled the Realms of Ruins amidst all the chaos, featuring numerous underground ruins shaped by elemental powers. Inside, you'll encounter diverse trials, including puzzles, timed challenges, mazes, and battles. The powers and treasures left behind by Saga await your discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b388bc58f1836d98323009945b02500dd86bdbc5.gif[/img]

[h3]7. Dynamic Wilderness Gameplay[/h3]
Dive into an open world brimming with interactive elements and fresh side quests. Hunt down the elusive claws scattered across the land, unearth hidden treasures beneath ghost-faced trees, and blast through obstacles with bomb flowers while dodging angry bee swarms. These new features add unexpected twists and turns to your epic journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/789b1aa5df901832b45fb15afb8edd160929b7b6.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a15da320972f1c721ebc3dd2ee82cfb67685c57d.png[/img]

Thank you to all players for your patience and support. 

[h3]We look forward to introducing the brand-new KAKU: Ancient Seal to you on July 12th![/h3]

New embeddable rune stones, which interact with each other, open up endless possibilities for customization.
Obtain a wide array of equipment, accessories, and rune stones by defeating bosses and exploring maps.
Saga The Creator has unveiled the Realms of Ruins amidst all the chaos, featuring numerous underground ruins shaped by elemental powers.
Inside, you'll encounter diverse trials, including puzzles, timed challenges, mazes, and battles.
Dive into an open world brimming with interactive elements and fresh side quests.
Hunt down the elusive claws scattered across the land, unearth hidden treasures beneath ghost-faced trees, and blast through obstacles with bomb flowers while dodging angry bee swarms.

notes.title: Official Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
To Adventurers:

[b]We're joining the Eastern Game Fest with the Official Demo![/b] The better news: the game will conclude its early access phase and transition to an official release this summer. This Official Demo includes many new gameplay features, the complete prologue storyline, and the revamped Kaku.

[b]❗Players who have purchased the game can input the branch password : bgkjdemo0424 in the settings to switch to the official demo version branch for testing.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/272f075f4d1a5426f0180fc33bae8c3ead5537be.png[/img]

We had many ideas originally and hoped to add them to the game during the early access period. But we are more eager to create updates that players will love. After the launch of the early access version, we collected feedback from players on various platforms. After intense discussions, we finally confirmed the updates that players wanted and decided to revamp the protagonist. 

However, these decisions have impacted the development progress, increasing the time required for development, far beyond our expectations. The game possesses four extensive maps and a multitude of cutscenes. And the majority of the planned updates are core gameplay, making it difficult for us to update the game while ensuring stability and integrity.

[b]Recently, as the content of the official version nears completion, we have been continuously conducting player testing, constantly fixing, iterating, and improving. We will transition to the official version in the summer.[/b] We are eager to let everyone try out the new content and allow new adventurers to experience the fun of KAKU: Ancient Seal. Therefore, we are releasing the revamped full prologue as a Demo, enabling everyone to experience it in advance.

[previewyoutube=OGRf8oXc55U;full][/previewyoutube]

[olist]
[*][b] Revamped Full Prologue: [/b]Complete new prologue storyline and gaming experience.
[*] [b]Revamped Floating Islands: [/b]In addition to changes in scene atmosphere and models, we've also optimized the jumping and layout of the floating islands. Players will experience two distinctly different atmospheres on the islands.
[*] [b]Brand New Protagonist Kaku: [/b]Players can control the brand new Kaku, who offers improved controls, actions, and of course, a more handsome appearance.

[*] [b]World of Ruins: [/b]The location of all ruins, with The Star Altar as the central point for upgrading and strengthening. Players can enhance their attributes, learn various skills, or challenge various types of ruins to win rewards.
[*] [b]New Piggy Skills:[/b] We've kept the most popular Piggy disguise and revamped the remaining 3 skills. The new skills include:
[list]
[*] Ripple Water Walk, which helps Kaku walk on water.
[*] Power Jump, which helps Kaku leap over ravines and cliffs.
[*] Spatial Teleport, which allows Kaku to freely travel to and from the World of Ruins.

[/olist]To celebrate the release of the Demo, we are also launching [b]a -25% discount[/b] on KAKU: Ancient Seal. Players who purchase the Early Access version will receive[b] a free upgrade to the full version[/b] at no additional cost. We will continue to work diligently to optimize and enhance the content of the full version for an early release.

notes.title: March Devlog
notes.content:
Adventurers,

This is probably the last development log. We've essentially completed the production of most of the new content and are working on numerical adjustments, balance adjustments and optimizations. 

Recently, testing for the new prologue and some of the elemental continents has ended. We will gradually test each elemental continent and the new content to ensure a better gaming experience for everyone. VFX, sound, CG, and values will continue to be optimized and iterated upon during testing.

[h3]The development content of this issue’s spoilers:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] CG/Animation/Synthetic Images
[*] The World of Ruins
[*] Rune stone system
[*] Transformation system
[*] Ponpon Quests
[*] Floating Island Reset
[/olist]
[h2]1.CG remake in progress[/h2]

We've completed the production of Kaku's equipment and weapons (including new designs). However, characters like Kaku and Nomin have been remastered, along with a large number of scenes. We need to redo all the cutscenes to better convey the story. Below is the new appearance of the tutorial chapter.

[previewyoutube=Fz-yA4-qwWA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]2: World of Ruins[/h2]

We're optimizing ruins gameplay while incorporating feedback from everyone. We've added new features like replayability. You can also return to star altar to upgrade with rewards obtained. Completing ruins challenges will increase maximum health or stamina, and we've added new vfx  for this.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]New menu page for world of ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/6f5cd532063288403e9ea2178a50bfe4235fd51e.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of blood totem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/ed36cfc723b2385a16e5924e2b497b163ba93a2e.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]3: Rune Stone System[/h2]

To enhance the playability of equipment and provide more choices in combat, the rune stone system has been introduced. In addition to exclusive rune stones for various styles or skills, there are also many fun and versatile Rune Stones that can be embedded in any equipment. Below are displays of several special Rune Stone effects. 
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Jump Rune Stone (slightly restores stamina upon jumping).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/487454c164fd7b80d6fb74592e1109839f81264c.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Clubbing Rune Stone (chance to stun enemies with the first hit of the arm blade).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/d4932d5847c811f3ce4086b9981ce5d236101258.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Transformation Enhancement Rune Stone (reduces the energy consumption of transformation states).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b584dcb5774e649441b61fad697bdb646889ac73.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]4: Transformation System[/h2]

We have redesigned all actions and effects of the transformation system. Additionally, we have introduced many Rune Stones related to transformation, which greatly increase the income in the transformation state. In the transformation state, Kaku will have an extremely large attack range and deal multi-hit damage. Whenever the collection progress of the blank stele reaches a level, you can activate new transformation skills.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of transformation moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b1a04193eceefa222375641eda85ee40ce1174cd.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Animation display of blank stele.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a261a4a965acbcfe19ffd9a7eb4fb62125bf6895.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]5: Ponpon Quests[/h2]

Due to the increase of explorable content, Ponpon quests have also been updated. The current Ponpon quests will guide players to explore the continent, or find hidden treasure treasures. Rewards can be obtained as the Ponpon book collection progresses. After understanding the full history of the Ponpon, you will unlock the ultimate prize!
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of Ponpon book rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/bdd1120f0423c2b03c62f6ef0fb0402e32c90120.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of ultimate prize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/d05bd840411ed4ce91f64aba33374d8507577dde.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]6: Atmosphere Iteration[/h2]

While creating new content, we have also been continuously iterating on existing scenes. Recently, we have designed two different atmospheres for the floating island and redesigned the entire floating island. By the way, we have also made modifications to the floating island jumping.
Display of new floating island in action.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of new floating island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/747f7467208c16350d8129a6120ddd52969fccaa.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of Corrupted Floating Island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b82569317551f6cd1b8f6686874ed54b97651bf3.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]The final devlog ends here, and we will bring the official version of KAKU as soon as possible. [/h3]

[h3]PS: We will release a DEMO soon~[/h3]

notes.title: January Devlog
notes.content:
Adventurers,

At the beginning of the new year, we bring you some exciting news. We are preparing to start testing the content of the new tutorial chapter so that everyone can experience part of the new chapter of the game. 

Many elements mentioned in this devlog will be available for exploration in the upcoming tutorial chapter tests. In the new year, we will be exploring new possibilities within the game world, introducing more gameplay innovations for everyone.

[h3]The development content of this issue’s spoilers (actual gameplay):[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Equipment adaptation
[*]Current display of the ruins world
[*]New piggy abilities
[*]Diverse ultimate abilities
[*]Land exploration gameplay and side quests
[*]New Ponpon camp display
[/olist]
[h2]1: Image of Kaku[/h2]

When the new Kaku could be initially controlled in the game, we began to adjust the existing equipment and design new equipment. We have made adaptability adjustments to the old equipment structure, and currently all adjustments have been essentially completed. After the adjustments to the old equipment are completed, we will speed up the production of new equipment so that they can be available to everyone earlier.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Equipment adjustment display.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/2fa87618eb478c2f123aad6e27fa0f4906eecf6e.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]2: The world of ruins[/h2]

The previous release of concept art and models should have piqued everyone's interest, and we don't want to keep you waiting for the final product for too long. In the past two months, we have completed the specific design of the ruins world, and it is now nearing completion (excluding special effects details and optimization). If you want to upgrade your attributes such as health and stamina, or get some equipment, you might as well visit the ruins world more often. When exploring on land, don’t forget to collect ruins keys.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Overall display of the ruins world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b7b722a5032beeed1fc8378008e64decd22b4601.gif[/img]
(Upper image: Before lifting the seal, Lower image: After lifting the seal）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/159d9679796d55ed324e7929baf66828814450ff.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/334c8659d1f1ac0d366745c9e74322fd24f5e983.gif[/img]
[/list]
The shell of the Wind Plate is like a huge closed, colossal set of wings, with surrounding stones delicately swirling like feathers, exuding the agile essence of the wind. The void is filled with mysterious purple clouds, which are atomized by the power of the wind element, and are often accompanied by thunder and lightning. Only by following the path of the wind can adventurers travel through it and dance with the wind.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of Wind Plate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/1208bd1eb0db6a5455c0685dbe546688949872b2.gif[/img]
[/list]
The Earth Plate is like the top of the sky ridge, mysterious and majestic. It seems to be the link between heaven and earth, like a tower of Babel. The entrance to the ruins is dotted on the stone tower like stars, and the texture of each stone is intertwined by Saga's divine power, ensuring that this summit of the celestial ridge stands eternal.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of Earth Plate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/f54cb967baa1c403e3e08040c35262559c8a0928.gif[/img]
[/list]
The Fire Plate is as gorgeous as a bonfire pattern and is made of lava. The black and red appearance exudes a fiery aura, with the red appearing to have the flowing currents of magma. White steam often rises from it. The void is filled with embers of fire, resonating with the red pulse. Only courage and wisdom are the way to survive in the fiery realm.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of Fire Plate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/cee98de3da62c3fd28520c13120a3cff56740d35.gif[/img]
[/list]
The Water Plate resembles the rolling waves of the sea, with each curve exuding beauty. Basalt-like stone pillars were constructed in the void, and water flows like a silver-white gleam, weaving through the pillars to create a natural water curtain that then disappears into the abyss of the void. The flowing water is at times melodious and at times surging, requiring adventurers to possess the talents of agility and adaptability in this challenging environment.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of Water Plate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/9e15d8a989f6ee57a74022cf212f460a5dd69709.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]3.Brand new Piggy[/h2]

The adorable big-eared Piggy is making a return with entirely new abilities, though the names for these abilities are still undecided. Now Piggy’s first ability, for now, let’s call it “Space Teleportation”. Piggy's horn can create an inexplicable connection with the ruins world and open the door to the ruins world. We hope this will make it more convenient for everyone to reach the ruins world when you have desires to explore ruins, upgrade attributes and learn new abilities.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of “Space Teleportation”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/93cdb415e3e77fc77d731ba1771077ef26a535c8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/c85e23707913cd5301f208dee36c905c7a3c16fc.gif[/img]
[/list]
Piggy's second ability is "Super Jump". Its big ears are finally no longer just a decoration. When faced with difficult-to-cross terrain, it will help you jump over them with ease.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of “Space Jump”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/7be9d93c949b5d68f6054e4e58d48a5e1cef0405.gif[/img]
[/list]
The third ability is "Aquatic Stroll". For a long time, everyone has been troubled by the immediate death when Kaku is exposed to water. So what if Piggy can help Kaku achieve water walking? Now Piggy can let Kaku leisurely stroll on the water through his own magic bubbles. "Aquatic Stroll" seems to be a handy tool for cheesing as well.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of "Aquatic Stroll".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/26632949adb0a60876230f93ee03caed285a7913.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/00fee9c822fe86bd31d10c3ea96099dad863028a.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]4.Diverse ultimate abilities[/h2]

Now that the ability tree has been completely reborn, the original ultimate abilities seem quite mediocre. We aim to provide more playability to the ultimate abilities, as the previous focus solely on dealing damage became somewhat monotonous. 

Considering the characteristics of the three ability types, we've added sustained burning fire damage to the ultimate ability of melee weapons, significantly expanding its damage radius. This should better meet the expectations of players who prefer pure damage output.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of main-hand weapon ultimate ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/4063d2fe277899b9756a26b922c3ace511fa38d2.gif[/img]
[/list]
After the ultimate ability of the off-hand weapon concludes, there will be a beneficial buff aura. Given the clumsiness of off-hand weapon attacks, leading to Kaku taking more damage, this enhancement is warranted. 
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of off-hand weapon ultimate ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/3e7039c71174aa2ce138d09d3e5fcf456862e61c.gif[/img]
[/list]
As for the ultimate ability of ranged weapon, it now can use the power of ice. Considering that ranged attackers typically want to maintain distance from enemies, ranged attacks can now slow nearby enemies.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of ranged weapon ultimate ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/0893e25a5538262be8509e480b0bd8018f3ff5c4.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]5. Land exploration gameplay[/h2]

New interactive objects bring more possibilities to the land exploration gameplay. We’ve added new side quests in many locations across the Elemental Land, which will increase the fun of exploring the land, as well as play time. More details will be waiting for you to experience in the game after we improve them.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of side quest .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/6b2f9d05a88233e217c37acbb74b0e5b233b1f90.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of side quest .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/d2b3dc132b8021c88f7dfaf1055197a5166ebfc9.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of side quest .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/ed98f16a48ed99cb71503fb89e34441390732c10.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]6.Ponpon’s Camp[/h2]

The harsh winter has been with us for quite some time, and we have all grown accustomed to stepping out bundled up in thick clothing. The kind production team has also thought about Ponpon; how would they withstand the cold in this weather? Therefore, the responsibility of building new houses for Ponpon fell on our shoulders.  

The designers would never make the camp tents are as clumsy as the Ponpons, and now adventurers can spot their weather-shielding homes from afar.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Ponpon’s camp display.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/23523cff564441d77a34b7b80e440026c6ad003e.png[/img]
[/list][h3]If you enjoy our game or have any other feedback and suggestions, just drop us a line on Steam. [/h3]

[h3]PS: The content testing for the new tutorial chapter is currently in preparation~[/h3]

[h3]You can check our game updates channel in Discord to find the latest development content.[/h3]
[url=https://t.co/Zhv4roh3CV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/d4fc5ed73c41a44890b6505455ea7c1658025dcd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: December Devlog
notes.content:
Adventurers,

The biting wind has already howled, and the carnival on the floating island has continued for several days.

While everyone is reveling, the December devlog is here as scheduled, and we hope the content will not disappoint you.

[h3]Development content that can be revealed this time (actual gameplay):[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Kaku character movement feedback iteration
[*]Current display of the ruins world
[*]New ruins entrance and key
[*]New battle ruins
[*]Main hand and off-hand ability branches
[*]Slingshot system
[*]New tutorial chapter scenes
[*]Land exploration gameplay
[*]Optimization of the atmosphere of the water element Land
[/olist]
[h2]1: Image of Kaku[/h2]

For the current Kaku, the running action of running on all fours like a savage is no longer applicable, and the previous character movement is considered by some players to be 'simple and crude' and lacks transition. We made a ‘starting’ animation for the new Kaku, and now his movements will be more vivid. At the same time, the emergency stop braking action has been redone to make it perform more reasonably.

As an adventure exploration game with a huge map, the map exploration experience is undoubtedly very important. [b]We believe that the optimized movement feedback will be refreshing for everyone.[/b]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]The standby state display of the new Kaku.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/85391c414fe8ac4a0363254299c689cebd954bfa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/7bcecca646521026d8b808800a3129e10b3ed6d3.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Comparison of running movements between old and new Kaku.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/57f2d8bf06b69b74e3ee12593718d0b1d7266eda.gif[/img]
(Above picture: New Kaku ; Below picture: Old Kaku)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/ea8b0bd44ce720a8648b4ce89c4169587b93e870.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]2: World of Underground Ruins[/h2]

Saga opened up a small world in the chaos, made some small mechanisms and trials in it, and hid part of his power and treasures in it. In order to prevent the divine power in the small world from dissipating, Saga set up a barrier so that the small world could swallow all light and be invisible to ordinary people. It was shaped like a sphere. Only the power of the ether can awaken the little world from its slumber and set it in motion.

Saga used the power of the four elements when creating the world of ruins. The four elemental ruin plates serve as supporting points surrounding the center, and each plate is designed according to the characteristics of the element. Models and atmosphere are still a work in progress.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of the middle stage of the ruins world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/7ef1535727c47f2179509857cc73fb712ac056a8.gif[/img]
[/list]
We have remade the entrances to small ruins, added a new kind of key to open them, and made new interactions and performances. Now, keys are required to open all ruins, and the number of keys required corresponds to the difficulty star level.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of the ruins keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/fd9db6d70b4d4fc54ab58d189005db451f1530ad.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Interactive display of ruins keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/de8a13d35920be94fbe6660f91062e51a045f09f.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Interactive display of small ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/3cc47768916b175695ad11244b06715b08e116fd.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]3: Ruins gameplay[/h2]

In order to enrich the gameplay of the ruins, we have given pellets more functions. Thunder pellets can paralyze some mechanisms, poison pellets can dissolve non-interactive mechanisms, and fire pellets can burn vines.

We are happy to tell you that in order to give you more possibilities when exploring, Piggy will have new abilities such as helping Kaku walk on water and super jump. We will give you a more detailed introduction after the function is completed.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Thunder and lightning paralyze mechanisms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/233e2e0881002505301d27abad5e2027474d8728.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Poison pellets dissolve non-interactive mechanisms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/d3a8fe32cc639e7d0c14715ce9966833c2f440c8.gif[/img]
[/list]
The birth of battle ruins is because many players hope to pass the level through force. This is also our deepening of the ruins gameplay. In advanced battle ruins, random buffs will be generated on the road to rewards. The differences between the battle ruins of each element are waiting for you to discover on your own.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of fire element battle ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/7a5220c27af5248885a7e429b99d24e7bf793afe.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Display of earth element battle ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/600902a1e6839e8def79e702b3e2f0028e4dd59b.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]4: Brand new ability tree[/h2]

Whether players choose pure melee combat, rely more on pure long-range combat, or prefer to rely on operations and timing to win, the new ability branch can satisfy you all. It greatly expands the possible ways of fighting. The strengthening of branches does not require the consumption of Ability Sacred Stones, and the points can be reset for free. We combine the characteristics and abilities of some bosses. After defeating the boss, players will unlock more powerful branches.

[b]The combat characteristics of using main-hand weapons are still fast and multi-stage, and the strengthening direction is more towards pure output.[/b] Because some players feel that the operation of ability release is too cumbersome and want the battle to be smoother, we have designed strengthening directions such as [Infinite Dimension Slash] and [Infinite Severance](names to be determined), abilities with multiple operations will have higher damage.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Comparison of the two strengthening directions of [Infinite Severance].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/6eef7384b34b0fe65b18767286f02c9628c8c8a6.gif[/img]
(Above picture: Infinite Severance; Below picture: Sword Energy of Severance)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/5d3d2987481eddd02875165603acedba5e623ca2.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Comparison of the two strengthening directions of [Infinite Dimension Slash].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/6bf7371ca653cd51c83980baa6d21c12f3b4ec4a.gif[/img]
(Above picture: Dimension Slash adsorption; Below picture: Infinite Dimension Slash)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/90663f1d18f6225c52d956843f0738dedb289a2e.gif[/img]
[/list]
[b]Arm shield combat has two directions, precision guard and perfect dodge, which rely more on operation and timing, and the acclaimed spiral strike.[/b] We optimized the feedback when using precision guard and increased the benefits. And a perfect dodge will enter bullet time, or release Dimension Slash immediately. As for the spiral strike, we have also simplified the operation and provided a branch to make it rotate more violently.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Comparison of the two strengthening directions of precision guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/87d5882dae9999b8bf9f027232af9a903d830a37.gif[/img]
(Above picture: Precision Guard Shield; Below picture: Precision Guard Projectile)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/479e15d20638e8f2b5927a7fe231ed27c35775d5.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Comparison of the two strengthening directions of perfect dodge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/0fe1a5ac96549e2c61eaa2fb2b3798985f6c7445.gif[/img]
(Above picture: Dodge Dimension Slash; Below picture: Dodge Diff-Dimension)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/1300c64d0cdc4115482124f2f40fc3bcbbe2a1c9.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]5: Slingshot system[/h2]

[b]We have given the genre of long-range combat more mobility and variety, and made the movements of long-range combat look less rigid.[/b] You no longer have to worry about being surrounded by monsters when using your slingshot! Faced with swarming enemies, pellets rain is also a good choice. But in order to avoid the battle being too repetitive and simple, we didn’t give it too many branches that increase damage.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Actual display of retreating continuous fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/3e3e0a73cad088d911e829e1051f22d41c0fbf34.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Actual display of jumping and rapid fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/e77fa63086d68cfb4d2ce0af4d6d4a7d5dd991f1.gif[/img]
[/list]
Players who like long-range combat will now need to think more when using elemental pellets. We have strengthened the styles and characteristics of the three elemental pellets, and their growth paths are completely different.

Thunder Pellets focuses more on paralyzing and controlling the enemy. As the level increases, Thunder Pellets' armor penetration will also become higher; Poison Pellets have continuous proportional damage, which is more suitable for elite monsters and boss battles; and Fire Pellets' continuous explosions and high damage have more wide range of uses. It is more important to use 3 types of pellets flexibly and switch between different pellets according to the timing during battle.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Thunder Pellets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/5cd1256e5937571ecec4a3a32e1228048383fca0.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Poison Pellets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/84f6ba807487be029d7c01827f848ce8b82c82be.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Fire Pellets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/5aa06a99315ef06a86a775a01e444c88af82455d.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Pellets and new interactive objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/df9658fa55e69cdcea774153a1c4f94049b6a3bd.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]6: Remake of tutorial chapter scenes[/h2]

We built the tutorial chapter scene based on the concept art. Although the actual scenes cannot be said to be exactly the same, they are almost similar.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*]Actual scene of four element land landmarks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/cb85c44190fbc0729e1dcb57f89321563b1555de.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Actual scene of the atmosphere art in the tutorial chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/8246dc49c1d416c815bf38d7394ca6252555e5ae.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*]Actual gameplay in the tutorial chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/0e73d6408f8f6a7bd3cdc5e6944f1e65104c21b8.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]7: Land exploration gameplay[/h2]

We hope that these weird interactive objects can bring new experiences to everyone’s exploration.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Exploding flowers.[/b] It can break through thick stone doors and reveal the hidden space behind them. Its range-type damage is a weapon when facing a group of monsters. And its renewable characteristics can also save pellets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/899f27fad64fee596c032607d3503aaa2db74ff9.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Claw of Baruch.[/b] It pollutes water sources, blocks roads, and is number one on adventurers' hate lists. Only elemental pellets can destroy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/1775064f208bb986f9cedb87a12e439941f4cc6f.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Honeycomb.[/b] Once it is attacked, the swarm will carry out sweeping attacks indiscriminately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/bd95289ff226a810f6964d9e3e1bfe7ee944db24.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/91809bac84d5e96d0ec7032fed44f8a7e7446fb7.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Poisonous mushrooms.[/b] When its inner bladder ruptures, poisonous mist will spread out, and even wild animals are afraid of its toxicity. However, all things interact with each other, and it is said that there is a strange flower that can dissolve the poisonous mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/542c630c8d14183ae055f3cc4259daf378202f5d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/173ce1f1bd9ff4fccf63fa9a2f06e67fbb7d4631.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Grimace tree.[/b] Some people say they are alive, and you can always hear whispers in the trees at night. This needs to be verified, but it is an indisputable fact that they swallowed a lot of treasures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/4ad4da59dff974209534bb4bb42330f605aa0150.gif[/img]

[h2]8: Atmosphere iteration[/h2]

While producing new content, we are also constantly iterating on the original scenes and atmosphere. This time, a reporter went deep into the rainforest and took the scenery in the water element land [Misty Swamps] at the risk of getting lost.
[list]

notes.title: November Devlog
notes.content:
Adventurers,

Greetings! It's been a while, hasn't it? Since KAKU was released in early access, we have received a lot of feedback, including a lot of support and encouragement. Of course, there are also many criticisms and suggestions. After collecting questionnaires and feedback, our team went through intense discussions and finally determined the content of free updates during early access (you can see it at the bottom of the Steam store page).

Recently, we are going all out to develop new content, and everyone on our team has put in the greatest energy to promote it. However, this took far longer than we expected. 

[b]Happily, all content has made significant progress. It's time to show you some of the results.[/b]

[h3]Spoilers for free updates during Early Access:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Character image
[*] The world of underground ruins
[*] Combat system
[*] Tutorial chapter
[*] Land exploration
[/olist]
[h2]1: The image of Kaku[/h2]

[b]We hope Kaku is a brave, cute and a little naive child.[/b] Children's ignorance, fearlessness and curiosity about the unknown may be more suitable for exploration and adventure. Unfortunately, the current Kaku is not loved by most players, and his image makes it difficult for many players to feel connected. Based on the feedback we collected, Kaku's image was completely remade, except for retaining some features.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Kaku still retains his iconic hairstyle, but has an extra braid.[/b] We tried multiple hairstyles, including but not limited to Mohawks, Saiyan, and various non-mainstream styles. (Fortunately we ended up choosing a more mainstream hairstyle lol)
[hr][/hr][*][b]Kaku’s head-to-body ratio has been adjusted, and Kaku has grown up.[/b] Due to the adjustment of his head and body, Kaku can now make more handsome moves.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Kaku now has his own totem.[/b] In order to emphasize Kaku's status as the "Chosen One" and in conjunction with the redesign of the [Ancient Seal] transformation ability and the [Blank Stele] system, we designed a unique totem pattern for him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/c75efe8c77a419b02ea019ea083d4ada624ca5bf.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Kaku’s facial features are more refined.[/b] We remade Kaku's facial features and greatly increased the number of bones, so he can now make more vivid expressions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/7d3065941aa709015c12d30e9fd87371c86c8f06.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]2: The image of Nomin[/h2]

As the heroine in the game: Nomin, after Kaku’s image was remade, her age seems to be somewhat different from Kaku. In order to better match the look and feel of our 'heroine' Nomin and Kaku, Nomin's image has also been reworked. At this point, many players might wonder why we couldn't create a playable female character. At the beginning of the Kaku remake, we did carry out related designs simultaneously. However, due to various reasons, this plan was eventually shelved.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New image display of Nomin.[/b] (To be honest, the new Nomin looks like the older version of Nomin's sister.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/3094360d5c13618cf46feb169ac22462e85c5155.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Display of new Kaku and Nomin.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/31877617c20c271df6648dd248d8f37fdfd131db.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]3: The image of Geiser[/h2]

As the character who has accompanied players for the longest time, the old man Geiser deserves a chance for a image update. The main reason is that some players mentioned that until the end of the game, Geiser seemed to have no shoes on and never looked at the player directly with his eyes exposed.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/04ee6eb1e6a1b7dbedea9d2ba1f98e57edb5316a.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]4: The concept of the underground ruins world[/h2]

In order to satisfy everyone's desire for repeated challenges to the ruins and to make upgrades more convenient, while also providing more space for newly added land exploration gameplay, the world of ruins in the void is now available. It is divided into four sections: Wind, Fire, Water, and Earth, allowing direct exploration of all ruins within the ruins world. 

[b]Now the star altar only exists in the ruins world.[/b] If you want to strengthen yourself or challenge the ruins, you only need to teleport to the world of ruins.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]The concept of four elements in the ruins world.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b4cbbbd05c5ab6f83f02b953d21e347173da8f6a.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]The atmosphere of the ruins world.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/4a78ae6a73c0962e112c99b7f806a1fba9623743.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Entrance to ruins.[/b]
[hr][/hr][*][b]The key to the ruins.[/b]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Brand new star altar.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/913ab716776ada82d2c07c296819ec007f582029.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]5: The gameplay iteration of ruins[/h2]

[b]We have added types of ruins, now there are battle ruins and puzzle ruins.[/b] The difficulty has also gradually increased. Now you can only challenge the two-star ruins by completing all the one-star ruins. Of course, rewards are still related to difficulty.

At the same time, [b]we have added the status of mechanisms and interactions with pellets. Piggy’s abilities will also be displayed in a brand new way.[/b]
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Interactive Mechanisms for Pellets.[/b]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New battle ruins.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a70acfc3c3a5350766085b053306f3d57ecb0f76.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]6: Brand new abilities tree[/h2]

Throughout our journey, our battles have always aimed for a diverse combination of ability styles and the exhilaration of Musou Games. However, the current version of the ability tree is still far from this goal. In the rework of the combat system, abilities such as Precision Guard that have poor effects and low usage rates will be deleted. 

Without taking any time to mourn the death of them, because soaring toward the battlefield were various new abilities, enhanced branches, and advanced feel. 
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Brand new UI of ability tree.[/b]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Additional ability branch enhancements.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/056b27df40c871d5b7d5de0793bb9c9052974f34.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]7: Ancient Seal[/h2]

Kaku's transformation ability was a bit overkill, so we completely reworked it and combined it with Blank Stele. The UI and representation of the energy bar that records transformation energy have also been redone.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Blessing ability activated for the first time.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/5faa19656b19e706cdb5a02a6ba194db9b536855.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Moves interface UI corresponding to the Blank Stele.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/f3f81ec7b7067a98362766bfea544d90eba60be6.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]8: Weapons and Equipment[/h2]

The remake of Kaku's image has resulted in almost all old equipment being unusable or requiring adjustments. We have added some new facial equipment to Kaku, and also designed new main and off-hand weapons for each BOSS.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]The set includes new facial equipment.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/cf72e564b1ca052f86247d68dea82f2a9c9a80fb.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New main and off-hand weapons of bosses.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/0db00d3cee14fd5699569e752e032c25dbd70311.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]9: Slingshot system[/h2]

The slingshot, often criticized for its limited effectiveness in combat, has undergone improvements through the adjustment of its abilities. We have removed abilities with low practicality. 

The original special pellets are also separated from the slingshot abilities and have their own growth path. As the level up, the pellets will have more additional effects. Now the slingshot system is as effective as the melee system.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New slingshot abilities and branches.[/b]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Independent pellets system.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/3c63410b485fc50b211d52a60eccc012ca2c72ab.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]New pellets crafting station.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/4418e98eee27ffc6bd91f0fda2b8a30e8d34669f.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]10: Process optimization and scene remake[/h2]

The tutorial chapter of the game undoubtedly serves as players' first impression upon opening the game, marking the starting point for everyone's adventure in the ancient world. In order to eliminate the old chapter shortcomings, the creation of a brand-new tutorial chapter had been placed on our agenda. We are continuously optimizing the scenes in the tutorial chapter and adjust the atmosphere.
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]We have integrated the landmarks of the Four Elements Land into the tutorial chapter scenes.[/b] While striving to retain the distinctive features of these landmarks, we are also working to minimize the performance impact they may have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/dd41009fc97d107b6f4bce7cf81e2b5a89b9b735.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Tutorial chapter concept art.[/b] Concept art is an essential part of improving the quality of the prologue and making the adventure more epic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/54ec083e1d40558b648ef76101a563e7ec1d2eb6.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]11: Land exploration gameplay[/h2]

In the current version, our world map is already quite large. However, we are still dissatisfied with the richness of the gameplay in exploring the land. Therefore, incorporating some novel ideas from players, many strange and wonderful things have been born.

In addition, [b]we plan to make some new campsites for Ponpons[/b], adding a more vibrant sense of life. It should be noted that the interactive effects of all new interactive objects are being optimized. 
[list]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Exploding flower. [/b] Exploding flower. Yes, this flower, glowing all over and resembling a dandelion, is indeed a bomb. Perhaps it could serve as a strategic weapon or be used to break heavy stone doors?
[hr][/hr][*][b]Claw of Baruch.[/b] This kind of claws, seemingly alive, are transformed from dark energy, polluting all parts of the land. Only the pure elemental power can break them.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Honeycomb.[/b] Destroying the comb will cause trouble for you and nearby monsters. 
[hr][/hr][*][b]Poisonous mushrooms.[/b] From a distance, they simply look like glowing light bulbs.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Piggy lottery machine. [/b] In order to let adventurers make use of their collected junk, the Piggy-style lottery machine makes its debut.
[hr][/hr][*][b]Grimace tree.[/b] Only god knows what secrets lie behind the grinning ghost face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/38e90780726230ed3fd6de041e9796d9f147bba6.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr][*][b]Ponpon camp.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a0bb453a08ad3e96fd8cd7ecb72c33d97d5f2236.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on June 7
notes.content:
Adventurers,

After summarizing the opinions and suggestions of the players, we found that the lethal mechanisms in the underground ruins have brought players a poor gaming experience. Therefore, we have recently modified the lethal mechanisms in all underground ruins. 

All detailed updates are as follows:

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimize the lethal mechanisms in the underground ruins. Now, apart from a few large mechanisms that can cause instant death, other mechanisms will gradually deduct blood by percentage according to time.

2. Optimize the first stage of the battle with the final boss[Baruch]. Added an attack prompt for Baruch's hand weakness, now there will be a flashing effect prompt.

3. Optimize the screen performance when Kaku is attacked by Lopdragon's flame. Now Kaku will have red borders all over his body, and the screen border will turn red.

4. Optimize the sound of rising and falling water in underground ruins.

5. Optimize the gameplay of the piggy level in the underground ruins [Lotus in Water].

6. Added a general effect when Kaku is attacked. There will now be a more obvious notification of being hit.

7. Optimized the performance of all lasers in underground ruins.

8.Optimize the third stage of the battle with the water element boss [Firmament].

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Fix the problem that the scroll mechanism on the right side of the Earth Temple [Journey of Stone] cannot be triggered again after the player "Save - Exit the Ruins - Re-Enter" after it is activated, which leads to the failure of the level.

2. Fix the problem that some mechanisms in the underground ruins will be affected by the frame rate of the game. Includes water cannon, water blade launcher, conveyor belt and more.

3. Fix the problem that in the underground ruins [Light Path], after the player moves to the platform through the springboards and saves, the game will save to the state that the springboards are invalid.

4. Fixed the problem that the player could use the ultimate ability and the piggy ability to get up immediately during the process of triggering the skill [Reborn] of [Blessing].

5. Fixed the problem that players would be trapped in the combat area after simultaneously defeating the wind elemental boss [Double Deer].

6. Fixed the problem that Kaku would automatically turn once when shooting with a slingshot.

7.Fixed the problem that the player dodges at the moment of shooting with the slingshot, and neither shooting nor dodging takes effect.

————
We will continue to pay attention to the messages of each platform, and continue to optimize and update based on your feedback, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on May 24
notes.content:
Adventurers,

The early access version of [i]KAKU: Ancient Seal[/i] has been online for two weeks, and we have seen many players have completed the level, but our update has just begun. What will be the next update? What's your favorite part? Which parts are you still not satisfied with? Please fill out the [KAKU: Ancient Seal Early Access Survey], your choice will affect subsequent updates! Thanks to the adventurers for giving us feedback on bugs and providing valuable opinions during the exploration process!

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScYVnZmxFkzb97wZ2K_nZnFRlxcPCXWhYvvXJRe81OneGxQRg/viewform?usp=sf_link] [[b]KAKU: Ancient Seal Early Access Survey[/b]][/url]

The recent updates of [i]KAKU: Ancient Seal[/i] are as follows:

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1.Optimize the determination of the monster's blood bar style. Now the monster's blood bar style will be determined according to the monster's basic attributes and the player's current attributes.

2.Optimize the determination of weapon attack and slingshot automatic aiming, now the priority of aiming at monsters is the highest.

3.Optimize the terrain in some areas, adjust the problems of vegetation floating in the air and players drowning in small puddles.

4.Optimize the proportion of the screen occupied by the cutscene animation, and add a short fade-in and fade-out effect.

5.Optimize the ruin terrain in the tutorial chapter.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1.Fix the issue that the fog on the map of some players still does not disappear.

2.Fix the issue that water splash effects will appear when walking on the ground in some areas of [Misty Swamps].

3.Fix the issue of smearing when the player moves in some areas of the [Dragonbone Desert].

4.Fix the issue that the cave with a hidden treasure chest in the [Snowfall Valley] of the [Howling Snowfield] is not displayed on the map.

5.Fix the problem that some sound effects of [Armored Bear] are not controlled by settings.

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on May 12
notes.content:
Adventurers,

We are very happy to tell you that after our continuous testing over the past few days, the custom button function for keyboard and mouse has now been implemented. And according to everyone's feedback, some bugs have been fixed, and the design of some underground ruins has been adjusted. The detailed updates are as follows:

[h3]Special surprise: [keyboard and mouse button customization] function is now implemented, and you can set buttons according to your own habits.[/h3]

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimize the puzzle solving pattern in front of [The Ancient Guardian] on the left side of the Temple [Storm Trial], delete the deadly mechanism, reduce the height of the player who is blown by the wind, and re-adjust the layout of the mechanism platform.

2. Optimize the terrain on the left side of the Temple [Storm Trial], and now you can jump back to the central platform.

3. Optimize the left area of Temple [Storm Trial] , delete some deadly mechanisms.

4. Adjust some of the death mechanisms of the underground ruin [Light Wheel of Time]

5. Optimize the death judgment in water areas. Now shallow water areas can be explored with confidence, players will not die immediately when they encounter shallow water.

6. Increase the danger prompt when the player is close to the water.

7. Reduce the difficulty of the underground ruin [Tempting Fate], delete some deadly mechanisms, and slow down the speed of the track.

8. Added tips on the loading screen: 
[Star Altar] : The closer you are to the Temple of Elements, the stronger the monsters are. You can use the Star Altar to improve your abilities to challenge powerful monsters.

[Chest] : Opening a wooden chest will give you the materials you need for daily use. Opening a stone chest will give you a chance to get equipment. Opening a golden chest will give you equipment.

[Locked Stone Chest] : If you get close to the locked stone chest, snow beasts will appear many times. Defeating them can unlock the chest, and you may get a headgear.

[Golden monsters] : Defeating them can not only get rich rewards, but also the golden fragments of Ponpon book that mark the location of the treasure.

[Underground Ruins] : The chests in the underground ruins are the key to improving life and stamina.

[Chest] : Prompts for the output of various treasure chests.

9. Optimize the echo effect at the entrance of the ruin from the cave in the novice tutorial.

10. Optimize localized language.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Fix the problem that the fragments which open the gate of the temple are saved incorrectly.

2. Fix the problem that the spikes of the underground ruins [Light Wheel of Time] launch abnormally.

3. Fixed the problem that in [Sacred Woods], [Emerald Riverbank], and [Rock Island] areas of [Howling Snowfield], Ponpons would not be revived and the side missions could not be completed.

4. Fixed the problem that the cooling time displayed abnormally when [Kylin Roll] were upgraded.

[h3]Known issues: [/h3]

1.At present, there are problems in some underground ruins where the wind speed of the mechanism is too fast and the frequency of jamming projectiles is too high.  We have identified this issue and will fix it as soon as possible.  Currently this issue can be resolved by lowering the FPS cap to 60.

————
We will continue to pay attention to your messages, and continue to optimize and develop new content based on your feedback. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on May 6
notes.content:
Adventurers,

On the basis of yesterday's update, we have fixed some bugs that will affect the game experience.  Thank you for your support since the game was released, we are still collecting and recording other problems you have encountered, and every piece of your feedback is very important to us.  If there is any progress in our optimization and repair, we will inform you as soon as possible.

[h3]Special Note: Solved the problem that the game could not be opened due to the conflict of the third-party input method.[/h3]

[h3]Special Note: Players using a laptop may display an integrated graphics card in the game, but in fact the game uses a discrete graphics card by default.  This is a text display error, we will fix it as soon as possible.  In addition, please turn on the power when playing, otherwise the system may automatically adjust to power saving mode, and then frame drops will occur.[/h3]

[h3]Anti-stuck: Press and hold the [number 0] on the keyboard or the [left menu key] on the handle to return to the previous save point.[/h3]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Deleted the spikes on the pedals in the ancient ruins [Drifting Fairyland] to prevent death by misuse.

2. Fix the problem that the fan failed to start in the ancient ruins [Light Wheel of Time].

3. Fix and update the translation errors in some places.

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimize most water areas on the main route, reducing the possibility of players drowning.

2. Move down the spikes on the laser wheel in the ancient ruins [Wind Rider] to prevent death by mistake.

3. The newly added hints and dialogue texts have been localized.

We will continue to make fixes and optimizations as soon as possible.  If you encounter problems during the game, please give us feedback, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on May 5
notes.content:
Adventurers, 

The Early Access version of KAKU: Ancient Seal has just launched on Steam. We have collected a lot of feedback about the game, and we have already fixed some issues. We will continue to work on bug fixes and gameplay enhancements throughout the Early Access campaign. Additionally, we’ve recorded the problems of optimization mentioned by some players, and are working hard to solve them. If there’s any progress regarding the aforementioned issues, we will update and inform everyone as soon as possible.
